title: Humoral Defense Record
description: A schema for recording humoral structural immunity signals in Yin-Yang Structural Immune OS. This record stores attack structure fingerprints, antibody signatures, memory status, review status, and defensive distribution targets. It is strictly defensive and does not define offensive behavior.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for the humoral defense record.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated.

source.description: Optional source context from which the defensive record was derived.

source_type.description: Type of source that produced the signal.

context.description: Brief description of the source context.

attack_structure_fingerprint.description: A structural representation of the suspicious or adversarial input. This should describe the attack pattern, not merely the surface wording.

hidden_premise.description: Implicit assumptions required for the suspicious input to succeed.

claimed_authority.description: The authority claimed by the suspicious input, if any.

target_action.description: The action the suspicious input attempts to trigger.

context_shift.description: Observed shift in context or role boundary.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 for this fingerprint classification.

similarity_reference.description: Optional reference to a previously observed similar structure.

matched_record_id.description: Identifier of the matched humoral defense record.

match_basis.description: Reasons why this record was considered structurally similar.

antibody_signature.description: A safe defensive response pattern associated with the observed attack structure.

response_type.description: Type of defensive response recommended by the humoral memory layer.

safe_response_template.description: Optional safe response template that exposes the structure without attacking the source.
examples: This request appears to require authority verification before execution. Please provide the authority source, approval path, and operational purpose.

requires_human_review.description: Whether this antibody signature requires human review before final action.

memory_status.description: Status of the immune memory associated with this structure.

known_pattern.description: Whether this structure is known to the immune memory layer.

recurrence_count.description: Number of times this or a structurally similar pattern has been observed.

first_seen.description: Timestamp when this structure was first observed.

last_seen.description: Timestamp when this structure was most recently observed.

memory_strength.description: Strength of the immune memory association.

decay_policy.description: How this memory should decay or persist over time.

human_reviewed.description: Whether a human reviewer has reviewed this record.

classification.description: Final or current classification of the structure.

review_notes.description: Optional notes from human or defense-court review.

defense_court_record_id.description: Optional linked Defense Court Protocol record identifier.

distribution.description: Defensive distribution targets for this humoral memory record.

share_with.description: Defensive components that may use this record.

distribution_scope.description: Scope of distribution for this defensive memory.

privacy_level.description: Privacy sensitivity of this defensive record.

non_aggression_boundary.description: Explicit safety boundary confirming that this record supports defensive action only.
